3014.title: Secondary panel loses the source tab on close
3014.rootCauseOneLine: The panel state overwrites the active tab without retaining its source, so close uses only positional fallback logic.

prReviews.topFinding: The static diff retains the prior active tab and checks it before the positional fallback.

3014.proposedFix: Retain a short-lived prior active-tab ID and prefer it on close when that tab still exists.
3014.caveats: The wrong neighbor direction depends on tab order. The failure to restore the source is consistent.
